basic_info.description: This beautifully appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo radiates warmth and energy, featuring an abundance of natural light from expansive windows and skylights throughout. As you enter the unit, your living room is enhanced by floor to ceiling windows and tray ceilings. Asian maple hardwood floors lead you through the living room into the the heart of the home which is a stunning kitchen, complete with a huge island perfect for entertaining. Equipped with sleek stainless steel appliances, this kitchen is a chef's delight and ideal for hosting gatherings. Down the hallway, Each spacious bedroom boasts its own ensuite bathroom, providing both privacy and comfort for you and your guests. This unit features a beautiful outdoor private patio, washer/dryer, and dedicated 1 parking spot w/ storage. Step outside, and you'll find yourself within walking distance of the best restaurants, bars, and shops North Beach has to offer. Whether you're savoring a meal at a local eatery or enjoying a night out, the vibrant atmosphere is right at your doorstep
